scope: Real DeepSWE active-KV handoff profiling; eight agents and a GPU request limit of four. This is a separate workload from the earlier four-agent native-vLLM comparison.

fixed.input_embedding: Same BF16 CPU UVA mapping in both arms

definitions.generation_throughput: Accepted server output-token counter delta / actual elapsed counter-sampling interval; includes unfinished requests, prefill, tools, restores and queueing.
definitions.model_turn_QPS: Model calls completed before the 900-second cutoff / 900; not completed-task QPS.
definitions.memory: Whole-device NVML used plus reserved, sampled at 20 Hz.
definitions.restore_time: Restore suspension to ready; excludes scheduler admission wait. Includes host preparation, transfer and completion observation.
definitions.host_prepare: Host wall intervals inside KV assembly; includes waits and overlaps other activity. Not exclusive CPU execution or PCIe bandwidth.
definitions.GPU_spans: CUDA event spans include host launch gaps and overlapping background work; not exclusive GPU busy time.

common: Private Query capture uses one owned allocation rather than concatenating another full-size tensor.
MeanK FP16 conversion uses bounded Query chunks (64 MiB for this geometry), preserving the full eligible-page softmax domain.
Query and batch budgets raised equally to accommodate the intact 2203-token instruction in task eight.
candidate: Coalesce immutable KV assembly metadata uploads per group.

KV_handoff.retirement_scope: Matched completion records retained by the bounded archive log; coverage and dropped records are explicit. This may omit early-window acknowledgments.

steps.scope: CUDA-event spans include host submission gaps, sampling, MTP and capture; not pure kernel time. Attribution by actual batch composition, exclusive groups. First/last batches are selected by host start; boundary slop is reported.

host_timing.scope: Complete spans within the formal window. Inclusive stages overlap; self times subtract direct child spans on the same thread. Parallel threads overlap and totals are not exclusive GPU time. Tracing/export adds overhead in both arms.

limitations: One 900-second run per arm; stochastic trajectories and task progress diverge. No confidence interval or maximum sustainable QPS claim.
Both timed arms include the same host tracing. These are instrumented real-agent rates; a trace-free production speedup has not been established by this pair.
The frozen qualified 5090 runtime plus the focused patches was tested, not every unrelated change in the current worktree.
Unfinished task workspaces are preserved and unscored; model-turn throughput is not task-solving quality.
The historical four-agent 239.25 tokens/s result uses different agents, query/batch budgets and instrumentation, so it is not the before value for this optimization.
Retirement-ack timing uses the bounded retained log; sample coverage and dropped records are reported.
KV reconstruction GPU checks are byte-exact. Query capture preserves values; bounded MeanK accumulation is checked against the full FP16 reference with floating-point tolerance.

interpretation_update_20261031.scope: Later source-path audit; original observed counters and evidence hashes are unchanged.
interpretation_update_20261031.metadata_path: The immutable metadata batching change is in _assemble_split_chunks. The measured raw-cache=0, resident-V-reuse=false configuration uses _assemble_generic, so this hunk cannot independently explain the observed pair.
interpretation_update_20261031.chunking: Changing assembly_chunk_blocks from 4 to 16 reduces submissions and increases a gather payload from 4.25 MiB to 17 MiB, crossing the 8 MiB parallel-gather threshold. These effects were not separately isolated.
interpretation_update_20261031.causal_limit: The 1.41x ratio is a single instrumented, live-task observation, not a validated production or metadata-only speedup.
